    - heading "Understand Reflection in Line" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Reflection in a line flips each point across a mirror line. In Reflection in Line, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. You can learn Reflection in Line by trying one small example instead of long theory.
    - paragraph: Choose the mirror line. Drop a perpendicular from the point to the line. Place the image the same distance on the other side. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, mirror: A mirror reflects shapes across its surface. Watch out: Sliding the shape instead of flipping it. Reflection reverses orientation across the mirror line."
